record.question: "Zawlbuk was called the traditional school of the Mizo". Which one of the following is not appropriate for describing the quotation?
options: It was used to train all the youth of village to become worthy and efficient members of the society
The art of hunting animals for food, on land and rivers was taught to the young ones by the experts inside the Zawlbuk.
It was a centre of learning tribal warfare
Corporal punishment was often inflicted on the ill-behaved young bachelors inside the Zawlbuk.
